category_title: Students with high mobility and off-task verbalizations during independent work
scenario_title: Table work and snack time transitions
minimal_context: The student is transitioning from table work to having a snack at the same table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that the table work is done, it is time to stay at the same table and have our snack.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves in his chair and begins talking to the student next to him.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from his chair and starts talking to various students at the table.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you want to eat out in the hallway?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. (Continues standing and talking to various students instead of eating his snack.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now that the table work is done, it is time to stay at the same table and have our snack.

STUDENT: (Moves in his chair and begins talking to the student next to him.)

TUTOR: Kyle, listen and watch.

STUDENT: (Stands up from his chair and starts talking to various students at the table.)

TUTOR: Do you want to eat out in the hallway?

STUDENT: No. (Continues standing and talking to various students instead of eating his snack.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: during table work and snack time
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: moving in his chair, standing and talking to various students

behavior_patterns.condition: When the teacher issued threats of exclusion ('Do you want to eat out in the hallway?')
